protocol: DECISION_PROTOCOL.md — no voting; each decision records question/options/facts/assumptions/cost-of-wrong/reversibility/decision/confidence/revisit-trigger/dissenters
decided_by: A0 controller, R7, evidence-led per EVIDENCE_RULES source priority

decisions.question: fw-context role in the final system
options: untrusted-but-contracted evidence provider under detectors + written contract spec + S-gated repairs (hybrid)
demoted to cache; grep+clang+rebuild as primary evidence channel
assumptions: agent orchestration can compose substrate queries with independent channels
measured-passing surfaces remain passing under the validated corpus
decisions.cost_of_wrong: If (b) wrong: Agent inherits silent errors at MVP; mitigated by plant-test admission and KC-2 A/B. If (a) wrong: repeats 945:0 drift (F-R0-18, A1-I1).
decisions.decision: (b) fw-context is an UNTRUSTED-BUT-CONTRACTED evidence provider: its output is evidence-with-provenance, never ground truth (AG-5). Fail-safe contract semantics (refusal-not-warn, exact-no-fallback, deterministic-enumeration, unsupported-data-refusal) are a written substrate SPEC (design-time); measured-passing surfaces are trusted WITH named detectors; defect-class surfaces stay quarantined behind S-gated Track-B repairs. Keep-list per A7's shrunken set: index + per-context ifdef views + direct call graph + stdio recording + export (pending SUBSTRATE-GAP-EXPORT costing). Substrate cap: 1 wave-equivalent until first end-to-end Agent case exists.
decisions.revisit_trigger: KC-2 A/B shows grep-arm >= substrate-arm on real bugs, or external replication refutes FAIL_PRODUCT as oracle defects

decisions.question: minimum fw-context trust bar before MVP
options: fix all 8 findings, re-certify, then build (S1)
per-surface tiered trust: measured-passing surfaces trusted-with-detectors, defect-class surfaces quarantined pending S-gated re-earn
zero substrate trust; every claim independently re-derived
assumptions: plant-test (7 FAIL_PRODUCT patterns + GA-1 macro probe + G10 slot probe) can discriminate detector coverage
out-of-band build-manifest diff is implementable in K1
decisions.cost_of_wrong: Under-trust wastes the only parsing asset and re-proves known facts; over-trust repeats F-V1-003-class self-masking at MVP.
decisions.decision: (b) TIERED TRUST with measured admission: Tier-1 = surfaces PASSing the frozen corpus (F-R0-13) used with named detectors G1-G9; Tier-2 = quarantined classes (bare-generator variants F-V1-003, C-form vectors F-V2-001, macro-value queries F-V1-001, single-line body search F-V1-007, transitive callback targets F-V1-004, compile_commands-only dead-code roots F-V1-005) re-earn ONLY via S-gated Track-B with guaranteed corpus coverage (GA-2 amendment). G1 instrument = OUT-OF-BAND build-manifest diff (A4 UQ-1: no in-band per-variant provenance signal exists at 0.31.0). C-01 ruling: both verdicts (READY_FOR_REAL_PROJECT_TRIAL / NOT_READY) are scope-true on identical code; the readiness claim is a HYPOTHESIS realizable only as a V6-disciplined measurement event (freeze-before-measure, blind oracles >=30%, holdout split, 10-case external replication).
decisions.revisit_trigger: [SUPERSEDED by s0_amendments.D02R: per-detector MUST-PASS, no aggregate] guard plant-test <6/7 hits incl. GA-1 macro probe, or MEASURE-GAP-CHANREP shows the independent channel unrepresentative

decisions.question: variant/context family support before MVP?
options: no - single-variant per index, multi-variant re-earns via measured need
assumptions: no wave-1 corpus target requires multi-variant truth
decisions.cost_of_wrong: If wrong in the permissive direction: self-masking divergence poisons MVP evidence; if wrong in the restrictive direction: variant-specific faults (scenario 01) stay unreachable — an accepted, labeled gap.
decisions.decision: NO multi-variant in MVP. One context per index; bare-generator+variant project class fenced (GA-4) until U3 is measured (MEASURE-GAP-U3 experiment). Variant machinery re-earns ONLY when a real multi-variant target is selected AND per-variant diff truth is measured (A8 re-earn event, concrete). Scenario-01-class claims stay excluded from any corpus until then.
decisions.revisit_trigger: U3 measurement (MEASURE-GAP-U3) shows divergence detectable and isolation cheap

decisions.question: callback propagation MVP-critical?
options: direct flows in MVP; transitive may-targets reported as uncertainty, not promised
assumptions: wave-1 corpus (07/08/PFC-1 + macro case) does not hinge on transitive callback truth
decisions.cost_of_wrong: Missed indirect fault classes in wave 1 - acceptable because explicitly labeled lower_bound; over-promising would fabricate certainty the index cannot back.
decisions.decision: (b) Direct call and proven function-pointer flows are MVP evidence (Tier-1); transitive registration may-targets are reported as uncertainty-labeled lower bounds (A3 R2 polarity), never as complete call truth. Full propagation is a family-#2 re-earn event. Scenario 02 stays OUT of the wave-1 corpus.

decisions.question: dead-code and vector surfaces MVP-critical or conditional?
options: conditional: discipline-level treatment only, fixes S-gated
assumptions: wave-1 corpus avoids both surfaces (confirmed by corpus choice)
E5 cross-check discipline is implementable Agent-side
decisions.cost_of_wrong: Scenario 04/05-class faults produce false 'no interrupt surface' or overstated 'dead' claims if treated casually; C-03 conflation is the known over-correction risk.
decisions.decision: (b) CONDITIONAL. Vector: surface unusable as-is; MVP uses E5 discipline (any vector claim requires >=2-surface cross-check) + G9 slot-classification detector; honest-empty vs false-missing stays a distinct classifier (C-03 residual rule: no 'no interrupt surface' conclusion from an empty get_vector_table without corroboration). C-form vector fix = Track-B S-gated. Dead-code: MVP emits 'unreachable-from-known-roots' with root-set attestation caveat (G3); compile_commands-only root redesign = Track-B. Scenarios 04/05 stay out of the wave-1 corpus.
decisions.revisit_trigger: any wave-2 scenario requiring vector or dead-code truth

decisions.question: exact lookup / pagination / query-honesty requirements
options: hard contract semantics: exact-no-fallback, deterministic pagination with truncation signal, refusal-not-warn, deterministic enumeration
assumptions: contract rows are writable as spec without code changes; detectors can plant-test them
decisions.cost_of_wrong: Best-effort lookups fabricate explanations from substituted symbols (scenario 07 class) and silently truncate (scenario 08 class) - direct RuleCard corruption.
decisions.decision: (b) HARD REQUIREMENTS, written as substrate contract spec (design-time) + named detectors with plant tests: exact-no-fallback lookup (wave-1 mandatory; scenario 07 in corpus); deterministic pagination with explicit truncation signal (mandatory; scenario 08 in corpus); refusal-not-warn on unsupported data (mandatory); deterministic enumeration; explain_condition context pinning (run-pinned context_id or documented waiver) per A8's F-R0-15 nondeterminism objection.
decisions.revisit_trigger: plant-test shows a contract row unimplementable without code change

decisions.question: first end-to-end fault-discovery scenario
decisions.evidence_note: PFC-1 basis: V2-Z3-ZEPHYR-WORKQ = PASS in .fw-validation/FINAL_VALIDATION_RESULTS.json (within the F-R0-03 58-case tally). Citation corrected per R8 audit item 7 (dangling label F-V2-Z3-PASS-SHA removed).
assumptions: PFC-1 planted case is buildable on the frozen host
macro-context case is exercisable via condition-text + build-file -D flags (in-band + out-of-band), no DB value read required
decisions.cost_of_wrong: A corpus that never touches a quarantined class cannot generate S-attribution evidence (GA-2 starvation); a corpus of discipline-only scenarios cannot validate mechanism discovery (A8 Q3 open).
decisions.decision: Wave-1 corpus = {07 exact-lookup-ambiguity, 08 large-fanout, PFC-1 workq lost-submission (first planted END-TO-END case)} + 1 macro-context case (GA-1 probe, scenario-03-shaped). Round 2 adds a planted quarantined-surface case (F-V1-007 single-line plant, scenario-06-shaped) per GA-2. Scenario-01 class stays banned (GA-4) until U3. Scenario 03 runs under the two-part facts+forbidden-overclaims contract (GA-3).
decisions.revisit_trigger: PFC-1 fixture unbuildable, or A6 S-stability run (MEASURE-GAP-SSTAB) shows Δ>20
dissenting_agents: A2 (conditionally withdrew IRQ-first in favor of corpus decision; macro-case inclusion resolves the precondition)
A8 (dominance premise Q3 remains open - acknowledged, not resolved)

decisions.question: MVP ground truth and evaluation method
options: hardened independent protocol (A6) with custody split and blind-oracle floors
assumptions: blind-oracle authoring and 10-case external replication are resourced outside the lineage
holdout custody in a single repo is feasible (A6's weakest assumption - ruled advisory if not)
decisions.cost_of_wrong: Self-graded evaluation launders the lineage's own verdicts (FR-R1 precedent, F-R0-11): every downstream S number becomes void.
decisions.decision: (c) HARDENED PROTOCOL: <=80% commit-derived GT rows; >=30% blind independent-oracle rows; >=1 field-log-derived fault case; custody split author!=custodian!=scorer (fallback custodian A0 + custody log); freeze-before-measure with hash logging; hold-one-out validation on the S rubric itself; absence adjudication inside the S-audit with ambiguity=>PRESENT default; S-stability run (MEASURE-GAP-SSTAB, Δ>20 invalidates) commissioned BEFORE any S-gated decision; KC-2 A/B (substrate vs grep+rebuild+clang+LLM on >=30 real bugs from 5 RTOS fix histories, blind oracles, pre-registered margin) pre-committed as the FIRST measurement; 10-case external replication; 58-case campaign re-runs per fix-wave. Until custody feasibility is ruled, S is ADVISORY and gates nothing.
decisions.revisit_trigger: custody infeasible => S stays advisory; external replication refutes FAIL_PRODUCT as oracle defects

decisions.question: next implementation wave scope
assumptions: S0 user gate completes in one capped turn
Track-B export pull event is named before wave-2 planning
decisions.cost_of_wrong: Another substrate wave with no Agent code repeats the 945:0 pattern; skipping the S0 gate builds on unconfirmed success criteria (the goal-level laundering surface A8 identified).
decisions.decision: (b) AGENT WAVE, gated: (0) S0 USER GATE first - one capped user turn confirming the acceptance rubric (A1-P1) and answering A1-Q1/Q2, recorded as an in-repo goal ADR (A1-P2); (1) build K1 Evidence Gateway + K2 Hypothesis-and-Rule Loop (config/condition family only) + K3 Audit-and-FP Harness on two-tier trust; (2) contract SPEC written, not coded (D06 rows + fail-safe semantics); (3) Track-B named pull event: raw-evidence export (macro values + single-line bodies) with cost comparison vs clang -dM -E (SUBSTRATE-GAP-EXPORT) before admission; (4) KC-2 A/B as FIRST measurement (pre-committed, D08); (5) S-buy contingency armed if bespoke skeleton exceeds ~2 wave-equivalents of plumbing; (6) 3-component build plan adopted; C5 deferred with family-#2 re-earn event; dynamic-leg R3 placeholder registered, not built.
decisions.revisit_trigger: S0 gate rejected/amended by user; KC-2 result favors grep-arm; wave-1 e2e case fails on a Tier-1 surface

decisions.question: explicit non-goals
assumptions: scope stamps cite the goal without redefining it (D-6 silent-narrowing guard)
decisions.cost_of_wrong: Implicit non-goals re-open the 945:0 drift vector in both directions (goal substitution AND silent narrowing).
decisions.decision: NON-GOALS for the next waves: (1) polishing fw-context as a standalone product; (2) treating green tests as a success metric (test-green bias); (3) universal static-analysis coverage; (4) multi-variant support before U3; (5) runtime queue-semantics simulation (two-part contract instead); (6) vector C-form fix outside S-gating; (7) generalization claims beyond the 5-RTOS corpus stamp; (8) replacing the goal statement (it remains the reference frame); (9) compiler-oracle arbitration as an MVP layer (host-blocked, WSL-leg instrument only); (10) shipping an MVP corpus without the planted quarantined-surface round-2 case.
decisions.revisit_trigger: user amends the goal at the S0 gate; U3 measurement re-opens (4)
dissenting_agents: A2 (held: scenario-03 ceiling does not demote R-O runtime-observable rules for the GOAL - the two-part contract keeps them goal-relevant; disagreement is about emphasis, not wave scope)

s0_amendments.authority: Direct user S0 decisions (EVIDENCE_RULES source priority: user goal > all). Ratified in S0_GOAL_ADR.md. Original D01-D10 preserved above and in archive_r7/DECISION_LEDGER.json.
s0_amendments.process_correction: Prior record of R8 user acceptance + DONE was INVALID (user acceptance had not occurred). Legal pre-S0 state: R8_APPROVED_WITH_OPEN_DECISIONS -> AWAITING_USER_S0. See S0_RECONCILIATION_REPORT.md section 1.

amendments.change: Two-tier trust replaced by T0/T1/T2. T0 = directly trusted WITHIN A NAMED SCOPE (validated semantics, no contradicting defect, explicit scope; provenance still carried). T1 = gateway-safe/fail-closed (K1 deterministically detects the unsafe condition and refuses/repairs/marks; T1 claims only through K1). T2 = quarantined (not safely compensable). Adjudication: CURRENT_CAPABILITY_MAP.md. No promotion merely because a detector exists.
amendments.detector_rule: Every Wave-1 load-bearing detector (G1, G4, G6, G7, G8) MUST PASS 100% of its mandatory plant tests (DETECTOR_ADMISSION_MATRIX.md). The former >=6/7 aggregate gate is RETIRED everywhere. Revisit trigger revised accordingly: ANY load-bearing detector failing its plant test blocks Wave 1.

amendments.change: Wave-1 corpus re-anchored to the 10-item rubric. C5 (single-line T2 case) moves from round-2 INTO Wave-1 (rubric item 4). A negative/no-fault control case is REQUIRED (rubric item 5) and is registered as GAP-2. Contract tests (exact-lookup, fanout) do NOT count as E2E cases unless reshaped (GAP-3). A real/public-source fault case is required (rubric item 2) and pinned via GAP-1. Full matrix: WAVE1_CORPUS_MATRIX.md. PFC-1 remains the first plumbing E2E case and must not alone establish usefulness.

Custody made pragmatic for Wave 1: author = solving Agent; custodian = A0/controller with blinded expected answers; scorer = fresh verifier context receiving frozen outputs + oracle only after solving; hashes/timestamps before measurement. If Harness separation is technically impossible: downgrade the affected metric and record it - never fake independence. KC-2 split: KC-2A small early diagnostic (after first E2E RuleCard path works) vs KC-2B full preregistered >=30 bugs / >=5 RTOS histories A/B governing LARGE substrate investment. NEITHER gates the first E2E RuleCard. External replication required before strong generalization claims, not before the first RuleCard. Anti-self-grading intent (blind oracles, freeze-before-measure, >=30% blind rows) preserved.

Architecture labeled FAULT_DISCOVERY_MVP_ARCHITECTURE_V1 - the MINIMUM architecture proving source -> evidence -> mechanism hypothesis -> RuleCard -> refutation, explicitly NOT the complete Agent architecture; later evidence may add/restructure runtime/dynamic evidence, state/data propagation, callback family #2, multi-variant, vector/startup, other families (Minority M1/M9 preserved). Wave-1 acceptance = the 10-item rubric + per-detector MUST-PASS; N/M symbols retired everywhere. No K1/K2/K3 implementation in the S0 task itself.
